add_row_id.description: Adds a sequential integer row-ID column (1-based) as the first column.

rename.description: Renames one or more columns according to a mapping.

select.description: Keeps only the listed columns in the specified order (final projection step).

parse_date_text.description: Parses a free-text date column into a canonical ISO-8601 date and optional year/month/day parts.

parse_number.description: Extracts a numeric value from a text column, stripping commas, currency symbols and units.

extract_regex.description: Applies a regex to a column and writes each capture group to a new column.

derive_conditional.description: Creates a new column whose value is determined by evaluating a list of conditions in order.

derive_math.description: Creates a new column using a mathematical or string-length expression over existing columns.

map_values.description: Replaces values in a column using an explicit lookup table, writing the result to a new column.

replace_value.description: Replaces exact occurrences of old_value with new_value in a column (in-place).

replace_string.description: Applies a regex substitution to a column. Use 'writes' to output to a new column without modifying the source.

cast_column.description: Casts a column to a given dtype (int, float, str, bool). Use 'out' to rename the result.

fillna_static.description: Fills NaN values in a column with a fixed scalar value.

fillna_dynamic.description: Fills NaN values using a strategy ('ffill', 'bfill', or the value from another column).

combine_columns.description: Concatenates several columns into one new column using a separator string.

trim_whitespace.description: Strips leading/trailing whitespace from one or more string columns.

filter_rows.description: Removes rows that do not satisfy a boolean condition expression.

sort.description: Sorts the DataFrame by one or more columns.

deduplicate_rows.description: Removes duplicate rows, optionally scoped to a subset of columns.

bin_numeric.description: Discretises a numeric column into labelled bins.

one_hot.description: One-hot-encodes a categorical column, producing one boolean column per unique value.

split_multi_value.description: Splits a multi-value cell (e.g. newline- or comma-separated) into individual values. Use explode=true to expand each value into its own row.

custom.description: Fallback for operations that cannot be expressed with the schema; the LLM generates Python code.
